app_info.subtitle: Reliability sidecar for agents
app_info.description: Use Agent Enhancer Utilities as a reliability sidecar around repeated, scheduled, parallel, quota-sensitive, or duplicate-sensitive agent workflows. Its 37 deterministic tools plan and checkpoint guarded work, coordinate opaque agents, inspect MCP and x402 contracts, and test bounded API failure paths. It is free and account-free. It does not automatically intercept other plugins and exposes no transfers, wallets, settlement, or real payment capability.

portal_submission.developer_identity_note: Use Agent Enhancer Utilities only if that exact business identity is verified in the Platform. If submitting under an individually verified identity, replace the developer name with the exact verified individual name shown by the portal.

listing.long_description: Use Agent Enhancer Utilities as a reliability sidecar around repeated, scheduled, parallel, quota-sensitive, or duplicate-sensitive agent workflows. Its 37 deterministic tools plan and checkpoint guarded work, coordinate opaque agents, inspect MCP and x402 contracts, and test bounded API failure paths. It is free and account-free. It does not automatically intercept other plugins and exposes no transfers, wallets, settlement, or real payment capability.

mcp.content_security_policy: Not applicable. The MCP server exposes tools only and does not provide a custom UI or output template.
mcp.demo_credentials: Not applicable. The production MCP server is public and does not require an account, API key, OAuth, or other credentials.

starter_prompts: Guard a parallel import: prevent duplicates and limit active agents to two.
Create a temporary 429-to-200 sequence to test whether my HTTP client respects Retry-After.
Compare two x402 requirements and flag changes to amount, recipient, network, asset, or resource.

availability.recommended_selection: All countries and regions offered by the portal
availability.confirmation: Select all offered countries and regions only if the verified publisher is ready to provide the public service, policies, and support there.

portal_submission.release_notes: Version 1.7.0 strengthens duplicate-sensitive external writes. The planner now selects workflow checkpoints instead of simple locks when a harmful write can overlap or retry, and the checkpoint records an external-attempt-started boundary before the domain call. A lost response is reconciled without blind replay. Tool names and the 37-tool count are unchanged. The service remains free and account-free, and it performs no real payments or asset transfers.
portal_submission.reviewer_notes: Use the production MCP endpoint at https://liberated.site/mcp/chatgpt. Authentication is None, so no demo account or credentials are required. The plugin has no custom UI, so screenshots and UI CSP allowlists are not applicable. Some tools intentionally create bounded, expiring private coordination state or unguessable public test-fixture URLs; their annotations and justifications describe those effects. The x402 tools only analyze caller-supplied protocol requirements and cannot sign, settle, transfer funds, or access a wallet. Use fresh UUID-v4 values in tests to avoid collisions. A public walkthrough is available at https://liberated.site/demo.mp4.
policy_attestation_notes: The listing, URLs, tool metadata, skills, tests, and release notes describe the production release accurately.
The service does not require authentication and reviewers do not need credentials, MFA, email confirmation, SMS confirmation, or private-network access.
Tool responses are designed to exclude credentials, unnecessary personal data, raw webhook bodies, source IPs, debug payloads, and undisclosed user identifiers.
The plugin cannot perform real payments, transfers, wallet operations, settlement, signing, messaging, publishing, or writes through another plugin.
The bundled skills were tested using the same final file tree included in the upload archive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Acquiring a lock creates temporary coordination state, so this tool is not read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: The lock exists only in the service's private coordination store and cannot change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: The lock expires automatically and does not delete or overwrite user data.

justifications.open_world_justification: Seen-state is confined to the service's private store and is not published externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: The operation adds bounded expiring state and does not delete or overwrite user content.

test_cases.description: Bound parallel work performed through another plugin without sending that plugin's private records to the sidecar.
test_cases.user_prompt: I will use another plugin to process opaque items with three workers. Generate one private namespace as sidecar-review:<fresh UUID-v4>, reuse it for the related coordination calls, and use opaque key batch-42. Limit active workers to two and share a two-token-per-minute request gate. Acquire a permit and one token for worker-a, then report the guard evidence and explain that it does not prove the other plugin completed its action.
test_cases.expected_output: The semaphore admits worker-a within capacity two and the rate gate allows one unique token operation, using separate stable idempotency keys for the two sidecar calls. The response reports only opaque guard evidence, labels the result rate/concurrency-bounded, and states that neither result proves the external plugin completed.

test_cases.description: Create a bounded 429-to-500-to-200 retry fixture and confirm that its URL advances once per request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a short-lived retry fixture that returns 429, then 500, then 200, with no artificial delay and a 300-second lifetime. Then request the returned fixture URL three times and report the status sequence.
test_cases.expected_output: The tool returns an HTTPS fixture_url, sequence [429, 500, 200], max_hits 3, and exhausted_status 410. Three successive GET requests return 429, 500, and 200; a later request returns 410.

test_cases.description: Lint a closed read-only MCP lookup contract and verify that its schema and annotations produce no findings.
test_cases.user_prompt: Lint this closed, read-only MCP lookup contract and summarize any findings: tool name lookup_entry; description 'Retrieve one bounded entry without external side effects.'; one required string input named key; no additional properties; readOnly true, destructive false, openWorld false, idempotent true; no authentication.
test_cases.expected_output: The tool returns ok=true with result.valid=true, finding_count 0, checked_rules 9, and an empty findings array.

test_cases.description: Compare two x402 requirements that differ only in their atomic amount and verify the exact changed field.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare these two x402 requirements and report exactly what changed. Before: exact scheme, eip155:8453, USDC, amount_atomic 1000, pay_to 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111, resource https://api.example.invalid/job, no extensions. After: identical except amount_atomic is 2000.
test_cases.expected_output: The result reports changed=true, changed_fields containing only amount_atomic, commercial_terms_changed=true, retry_binding_changed=false, and distinct SHA-256 fingerprints. No payment or network action occurs.

test_cases.description: Plan a scheduled duplicate-sensitive external create from the closed capability contract.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use the workflow planner for a scheduled create with three workers, retries possible, material duplicate harm, no provider idempotency, eventual destination search, a stable marker, read-after-write, no conditional write, manual compensation, and no shared rate limit. Do not create anything.
test_cases.expected_output: The tool returns decision sidecar, profile create-once, additional profile scheduled-run, guarantee duplicate-resistant, search before create, read-back after create, and explicit eventual-search and cross-plugin-transaction residual risks. It creates no state.

negative_test_cases.description: A general-knowledge history question should not invoke a reliability utility.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize the causes of the French Revolution.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answer from general knowledge without selecting an Agent Enhancer Utilities tool.

negative_test_cases.description: An ordinary one-time write in another plugin should not add sidecar calls.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create this one Notion note for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Use the Notion plugin if available without selecting Agent Enhancer Utilities. No repeated, parallel, scheduled, quota, freshness, retry, or duplicate-sensitive concern was stated.

negative_test_cases.description: A cryptocurrency transfer request must not invoke the plugin's analysis-only x402 tools.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not select a plugin tool; explain that the plugin cannot transfer funds. Its x402 tools only analyze caller-supplied protocol contracts.
